summaryFields.name: customer_name
summaryFields.label: Customer
summaryFields.description: Customer's name exactly as the bot addressed them in the greeting (the dialer record). Null if the bot never said a name.

summaryFields.name: product_name
summaryFields.label: Product
summaryFields.description: Haier product the bot named in its purpose line (TV, Split AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, ...). Null if not named.

summaryFields.name: wo_number
summaryFields.label: WO / reference number
summaryFields.description: Work-order or request number ONLY if one was spoken on the call (by the bot or the customer). Not sent by the dialer today, so usually null; never invent one.

summaryFields.name: rejection_reason
summaryFields.label: Original rejection reason
summaryFields.description: Field-team rejection code the call was about (dialer value).

summaryFields.name: identity_confirmed
summaryFields.label: Identity confirmed
summaryFields.description: Did the person on the call confirm being the named customer? Yes only on an explicit confirmation to the bot's identity question; No when they said they are not that person.

summaryFields.name: technician_contact
summaryFields.label: Technician call/visit
summaryFields.description: What the customer said about contact from the Haier technician before this call: called = a call came (no visit), visited = a technician visited, no_contact = no call and no visit. Null when not discussed.
summaryFields.extractionInstructions: Only the customer's own statement counts. 'Call aaya tha / baat hui thi' = called. 'Technician aaya tha / visit hui thi' = visited. 'Koi call ya visit nahi hui / koi nahi aaya' = no_contact. A bare haan/nahi counts only as the answer to the bot's technician question immediately before it.

summaryFields.name: customer_statement
summaryFields.label: Customer's explanation / objection
summaryFields.description: The customer's own explanation of what happened or their objection, in their words (transliterate Hindi if needed), one or two short clauses. Null if they only answered yes/no.

summaryFields.name: service_required
summaryFields.label: Service still required
summaryFields.description: Customer's current service requirement: yes = wants the technician visit, no = no service needed, later = wants it at a later date.
summaryFields.extractionInstructions: Use the customer's answer to 'kya aapko service ki requirement hai' or an equivalent statement. 'Baad mein / abhi nahi, X din baad' = later.

summaryFields.name: issue_resolved
summaryFields.label: Issue resolved
summaryFields.description: Whether the original problem is already resolved and by whom, per the customer: not_resolved, resolved_by_haier_technician, resolved_without_haier (worked on its own / self / someone else).
summaryFields.extractionInstructions: 'Problem abhi bhi hai / kaam nahi hua' = not_resolved. 'Technician ne theek kar diya / installation Haier ne kar di' = resolved_by_haier_technician. 'Apne aap theek ho gaya / khud karwa liya / bahar se karwaya' = resolved_without_haier. Null when the customer never said.

summaryFields.name: requested_timing
summaryFields.label: Requested callback/visit timing (as said)
summaryFields.description: When the customer wants the technician visit or a callback, in their own words (e.g. 'kal subah', '10 din baad', 'next week'). Null if no timing was given.

summaryFields.name: requested_date
summaryFields.label: Requested date (ISO)
summaryFields.description: The requested visit/callback day as an absolute date, only when the customer's words pin a specific day (kal, parso, Monday, 15 tarikh). Null for vague timing.

summaryFields.name: customer_confirmed_action
summaryFields.label: Customer confirmed bot's action
summaryFields.description: After the bot stated its action (forwarding for re-dispatch / for cancellation), did the customer explicitly agree or acknowledge (theek hai, haan, ok)? No only on an explicit objection; null when the call ended before any reply.

summaryFields.name: dnc_requested
summaryFields.label: Do-not-call requested
summaryFields.description: Customer asked not to be called again / complained about repeated calls and wanted them stopped.

summaryFields.name: workflow_outcome
summaryFields.label: Workflow decision
summaryFields.description: The end node the guided flow reached (platform-recorded). Null when the call ended before the flow concluded.

summaryFields.name: disposition
summaryFields.label: Disposition

values.cancel_resolved: Connected – Issue Resolved (Either by customer or local Tech.)
values.close_completed_other: Connected – Issue Resolved (Either by customer or local Tech.)
values.redispatch_completion: Connected – Issue Resolved by Haier Tech

options: Connected – Issue Resolved by Haier Tech
Connected – Issue Resolved (Either by customer or local Tech.)
summaryFields.description: Official Haier POC disposition derived from the workflow decision (platform-recorded). The four Not Connected values are reserved for telephony/dialer evidence and are never produced from conversation text; Unmapped (needs review) marks outcomes the client rules do not cover.

summaryFields.name: disposition_reason
summaryFields.label: Disposition reason

values.redispatch: Customer still needs the service; request forwarded for re-dispatch
values.cancel_gift: Product is a gift; recipient to raise the request
values.cancel_resale: Bought for resale; no installation needed
values.cancel_resolved: Product working fine now without a Haier visit; forwarded for cancellation
values.close_completed: Customer reports installation/service completed, nothing pending; who did it could not be confirmed (needs review)
values.cancel_no_service: Customer does not need the service
values.other_issue_noted: Customer raised a different issue; noted, no action on this request (disposition needs review)
values.repeat_calls_noted: Customer asked to stop the calls; noted and forwarded (disposition needs review)
values.cancel_ecom_damaged: E-com damaged delivery; customer to replace via the seller and raise a new request
values.cancel_not_delivered: Product not delivered yet; customer to raise a new request after delivery
values.cancel_service_later: Service wanted after the 5-day window; customer to raise a new request when needed
values.unverified_no_action: Status could not be confirmed on the call; no action taken (disposition needs review)
values.close_completed_other: Installation/service completed by the customer or a local technician, nothing pending; forwarded for closure
values.existing_request_open: A request for this is already open; no duplicate created (disposition needs review)
values.redispatch_completion: Problem fixed by a Haier technician; forwarded to close as completed
values.existing_case_followup: Customer has an open case; forwarded for follow-up on it (disposition needs review)
values.cancel_payment_declined: Customer not ready to pay the service charges
values.wrong_person_no_request: Wrong contact: no such request raised; forwarded for cancellation
values.wrong_person_unavailable: Customer not available on this number now; call again
values.wrong_person_no_haier_product: Wrong contact: no Haier product; forwarded for cancellation

summaryFields.description: Concise reason for the disposition (platform-recorded from the workflow decision).

summaryFields.name: cancel_reason
summaryFields.label: Cancellation sub-reason
summaryFields.description: Why the work order is being cancelled (only for CANCEL_WO).

summaryFields.name: backend_action_status
summaryFields.label: Backend execution
summaryFields.description: Whether the re-dispatch/cancellation was actually executed in Haier's system. No CRM integration is configured for this bot, so the bot only FORWARDS the request: no_integration_configured means nothing was executed by the platform.

summaryFields.name: call_completion
summaryFields.label: Call completion
summaryFields.description: How the conversation ended: flow_completed = the bot reached its closing line (dhanyavaad / din shubh rahe); customer_disconnected_midway = the platform facts show end_reason caller_hangup before the closing; ended_without_outcome = anything else (silence, bot-side end before a decision).
summaryFields.extractionInstructions: Decide from the platform facts (end_reason) and the last bot turn, not from guesses about the customer.
